If you’re okay, I’ll loop in Grace (CS lead) and Laura (finance) to propose a signoff and activation path that reduces friction.

Next step: if we can confirm approval list and desired term, I’ll send an updated private offer with negotiated SKUs and a DocuSign link.

Hi Rishi — thanks for sending. Quick answers:

- Term: Procurement prefers a 12-month committed contract for vendor management sanity, but we can accept a 3-month pilot addendum if the pilot is limited to a subset of accounts and we have clear cutover metrics.
- Approvers: For anything under $150k ARR, procurement + IT security review is sufficient (usually 2–3 weeks). Above $150k requires CFO (Daniel) signoff and legal review (4–6 weeks).

I'll attach our internal approval checklist to the procurement alias. Two asks from our side: can you add a clause that ensures data residency logs for the pilot (we're in the process of a SOC audit), and can you clearly call out who at Redwood will own activation and onboarding?

Maria
Maria Sun | Head of Procurement, Skyline Health

Rishi / Laura —

Thanks for the heads up. Operational playbook below (high level):

Option A — Standard 12-mo committed (recommended):
- Offer: 12 mo, usage tiers as in SKU_Pricing_Scenarios.xlsx, 10% annual discount.
- Approval path mapping: procurement + IT sec (2–3 wks). If they accept, activation owner: Grace O'Connor (CS).
- Billing: standard annual commit invoiced up front or quarterly per finance preference.

Option B — Pilot + conversion (for procurement who want runway):
- Offer: 3-mo pilot limited to 25% of accounts (usage capped), pilot billed monthly at pilot rates; automatic conversion to 24-mo committed at conversion price if activation metrics met.
- Approval path mapping: procurement OK, but CFO signoff required for conversion pricing if total committed ARR >$150k.
- Operational mitigation: we include a data-residency and logs addendum for pilot (CS ops can supply audit logs). Onboarding owner: Grace + named Solutions Engineer.

Recommendation: present both options but highlight Option A as lower procurement friction. Laura — can you confirm whether Finance can accept pilot monthly billing with automated conversion, or do we need manual POs? If manual invoicing required, we should avoid pilot conversion automation.

Grace

Quick finance check: we can support monthly pilot billing and programmatic conversion to committed billing, but only if the customer signs a purchase order that authorizes the conversion ahead of time. No manual re-invoicing required if PO is in place.

If they prefer no PO, we will need a short manual step at conversion (billing support). Recommend we ask procurement to provide their standard PO template and Daniel to pre-authorize the conversion in the same doc to avoid delay.

Also note: for >$150k ARR deals, finance will require visible CFO approval in DocuSign metadata for audit. I can add that field to the DocuSign envelope.

Maria — great, thanks for the clarity. Based on your input and ops/finance confirmation, we propose two clean paths:

1) Option A — 12-mo committed: 10% discount, procurement + IT sec approvals. Activation/Onboarding owner: Grace O'Connor. We can accept standard Skyline PO; finance will add CFO DocuSign metadata if needed.

2) Option B — 3-mo pilot then conversion: pilot billed monthly (no manual re-invoicing if Skyline provides a PO that authorizes conversion). Pilot limited to 25% of accounts; include data-residency & logs addendum for SOC audit. Conversion to 24-mo committed at pre-agreed price if activation metrics met; conversion will require CFO signoff if committed ARR > $150k (we'll make that transparent in the DocuSign flow).

Attached: updated draft (I removed the auto-conversion clause unless you can provide a PO) and a one-page summary you can circulate to Daniel. If you’re good with either path, I’ll send a DocuSign with the two-option addendum and a request for Daniel’s signature on the selected path.

Next step: please confirm which path (A or B) you want to pursue and whether procurement can provide a PO that pre-authorizes conversion for Option B.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call with Daniel and procurement to close.

Best,
Rishi
